scope: By immunoprecipitating TAF-containing complexes from different cellular compartments, we identify a novel endogenous TFIID subcomplex formed by TAF2, 8 and 10 in the cytoplasm of human cells.

7TAF complexes were produced as described. 8TAF complexes were reconstituted from purified 7TAF complexes by adding twofold molar excess of TAF2 and removal of unbound TAF2 by SEC.
